title: Laundromat
description: Twenty machines in a strip mall next to a college. Open all night, no employees, quarters every day.

title: Eight-Unit Apartment Building
description: Brick building, full occupancy, a property manager already in place. The rent covers the mortgage with room to spare.

title: Forty Acres Outside Town
description: Farmland the city is growing toward. It earns nothing today and costs taxes, but a developer may come calling.

title: Car Wash
description: Automatic tunnel wash on a busy corner. A manager runs it; you check the numbers once a month.
